_help: General settings. Change the values, keep the quotes and commas. See README.md > 'Tuning the Shape Challenge' for advice.

_notes.bangla: কথায় কথায় বাগধারা: challengesToWin = correct answers needed for the gift. Players always answer all challenges; the gift code appears at the end if they reached this number. Gift codes use the same rewardCodeSecret as Math.
_notes.english: Verb Hunt: players pick one level and complete it. passAccuracy = accuracy (0-100) needed for the gift; accuracy = (correct taps − wrong taps) ÷ verbs in that level. timeLimitSeconds = time for the level (180 = 3:00); 0 = no time limit. Gift codes use the same rewardCodeSecret as Math.
_notes.science: Science Challenge: timeLimitSeconds = length of a round, challengesToWin = correct answers needed for the gift, shuffleChallenges = true to show the challenges in a random order each game. Gift codes use the same rewardCodeSecret as Math.
_notes.timeLimitSeconds: Length of the Shape Challenge in seconds (120 = 2:00).
_notes.shapesToWin: How many shapes must be completed to win.
_notes.passThreshold: Accuracy (0-100) needed to complete a shape.
_notes.strictness: Overall difficulty. 1.0 = normal, 1.2 = harder, 0.8 = easier. Try small steps of 0.1.
_notes.minDrawingSize: Drawings smaller than this fraction of the canvas are rejected with 'Draw it bigger!'.
_notes.showScoreDetails: true = show the score breakdown (shape / coverage / closure / corners) after every drawing. Useful while tuning; set back to false for the event. You can also add ?debug to the URL.
_notes.rewardCodeSecret: Any secret word. It makes the reward codes checkable on the #/verify page. Change it before the event and don't share it.
_notes.advancedScoring: Fine-grained scoring knobs; only change these if strictness alone isn't enough. errorTolerance: average wobble (fraction of the shape's radius) that scores 0%. vertexNear/vertexFar: how close the stroke must pass to each corner. closureGap/closurePenalty: how much an unclosed shape costs. cornerWeight: how much a polygon loses if it has rounded instead of sharp corners.
